svg.title: The showroom — selected works on a turntable
svg.desc: Ten selected projects stand as holographic cards on a turntable that turns every 3 seconds, bringing each one to the front under a spotlight: its emblem, class, signature move, code size, commits and languages from the GitHub API, and, for the 4 with a live demo, whether its last health check found it online. ShopKart (E-Commerce · Mern): Transactional cash-on-delivery checkout, 210 KB of code, 17 commits, online in 231 ms; jsh (Systems · Java): Pipelines and background job control, 24 KB of code, 50 commits, source; AI Merchant Copilot (Ai Product · Retail): Camera stock-in with GPT-4o-mini vision, 534 KB of code, 61 commits, source; AI Video Studio (Ai Product · Media): Local Whisper, burned in by FFmpeg, 174 KB of code, 14 commits, source; Financial Health Card (Fintech · Explainable Ml): An explainable score and a credit limit, 112 KB of code, 14 commits, source; BlockPhantom (Web3 · Hackathon Finalist): Wallet risk score and a PDF report, 46 KB of code, 5 commits, source; Agentra (Web · Team Build): An interactive 60 FPS 3D showcase, 201 KB of code, 29 commits, online in 964 ms; BloodConnect (Social Impact · Web): One-tap donation requests, 28 KB of code, 5 commits, online in 97 ms; AI Image Classifier (Computer Vision): A MobileNetV2 verdict in about a second, 4 KB of code, 6 commits, source; AI-ML Club Ideas (Community · Ai-Ml Club): Problem to first version to demo, six times, 28 KB of code, 2 commits, online in 113 ms.
